profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU. On its own website, Micron describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. The site presents mobile memory and storage as accelerating AI-driven technologies, and offers design tools and resources for testing, building, and maintaining high-performance solutions, along with data sheets, technical documentation, a Technology Enablement Program, sales support, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples.

The company's recorded law exposure is in Idaho, with a count of 21. No lawsuits, AI products, or MCP servers are listed in the record.
